mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_places ( trip_plan_id, attraction_id, name, latitude, longitude, visit_day, order_index, memo ) VALUES ( #{tripPlanId}, #{attractionId}, #{name}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{visitDay}, #{orderIndex}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, trip_plan_id, attraction_id, name, latitude, longitude, visit_day, order_index, memo, created_at, updated_at FROM trip_places WHERE trip_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN visit_day IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, visit_day ASC, order_index ASC, id ASC
